item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President directs the Administrator to provide periodic progress reports and recommendations and assigns planning functions among executive organizations; these are internal reporting, planning, and coordination actions without a specified legal consequence for outside parties.","evidence":"I shall expect periodic reports from you on the progress of such Federal agency support"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President requests the Administrator's ongoing participation in Cabinet meetings and recommendations concerning civil-defense organization and legislation; any legal change would occur only through later legislation, not this segment.","evidence":"From now on I request that you also participate in Cabinet meetings"},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The segment describes the President's planned participation and expresses general policy views, appreciation, and aspirations; it does not direct an agency or itself alter legal rights or consequences.","evidence":"One final thought I would like to express."}]}
